name: Near/Far Distance Precomputation Pass
definition: Renders voxel bricks to a render target to compute the entry (tNear) and exit (tFar) distances of rays intersecting the volume for each pixel, preparing bounds for the subsequent raymarching pass.
summary: The Near/Far Distance Precomputation Pass rasterizes voxel bricks to compute entry and exit distances, differing from homogeneous intersection by explicitly deriving depth bounds through geometry rasterization.
